sentences: An affine maximizer chooses an allocation maximizing a weighted sum of reported values plus fixed outcome offsets.
The textbook asks which valuation domains make these the only allocation rules implementable with truthful incentives.
Rich domains can constrain how reports may change outcomes if payments are to deter manipulation.
A characterization would identify when mechanism design is forced into this familiar optimization form.

The saved 2007 question does not spell out domain richness or incentive conventions, so the classification must not be extended automatically to restricted valuations or weaker equilibrium implementation notions.
